title: Warm Venezuelan Penne Pasta Bowl
description: A garlicky and cheesy Venezuelan dish featuring penne pasta in a mother-sauce-base, served in an earthenware bowl, perfect for a quick fix meal. This nut-free-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine, bringing the sauce to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer while the pasta cooks.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the sauce, tossing to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to an earthenware bowl and top with the shredded mozzarella and queso fresco cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, straight from the bowl, and enjoy the cheese pull.
